messages:
Maria: FYI, CTL (large retail) asked for an offline POC — sealed network, no egress. They want: signed bundle, SBOM, delta patching, and a clear upgrade cadence for EOL/patches. Any blockers?
Alex: quick clarifying q — expected cadence? monthly deltas vs quarterly full upgrades? also pricing: per-node license or reserved capacity? cc Jordan for bundle sizing.
Jordan: we can output a signed tarball + detached sig (RSA2048) and a manifest.json. Full bundle ~6.1GB (quant runtime + model shards). Delta patches typically 40–150MB depending on model changes. We support delta via chunked, rsync-friendly artifacts and signed manifests.
Katie: security checklist heads-up: require SBOM (SPDX), signed package digest (sha256), HSM-backed signing keys, vulnerability scan results, and CVE SLA (critical: 30d). Need KMS rotation notes for customer.
Maria: they also asked about license activation flow — zero outbound is a hard requirement. They prefer time-limited license files provisioned as part of the SOW.
Alex: license file with signed assertion is doable (offline). Need to confirm renewal: manual reissue or a scheduled maintenance window where they allow outbound check-in.
Jordan: recommended upgrade cadence for production: monthly security/hotfix bundles, quarterly minor upgrades (compat + perf), annual major migrations. For POC we can compress to a 6–8 week patch cadence if they want more velocity.
Katie: for airgapped POC we'll provide: signed SBOM, reproducible build manifest, and a signed digest (sha256). Also can supply a templated SQA/pen-test summary under NDA.
Maria: pricing Q — they're asking for a 6-month POC with 2 reserved nodes + enterprise support. What discount do we typically offer?
Alex: standard approach: 50% off committed monthly for the pilot, includes two support on-call credits. If they convert to Dedicated within 90 days we credit pilot fees toward the first term.
Maria: legal also asked about cryptography/export controls: confirm FIPS/TLS support and attestation materials.
Jordan: our runtime can be built with FIPS-validated crypto if they require. Will include deployment notes. Note: quantized kernels use AVX2/AVX512 on x86; ARM falls back to NEON-optimized paths — mention to their infra team.
deploy-bot: bundle-builder: created signed bundle v2026.03.15-poc-ctl sha256: abc123def4567890... (internal link: https://artifacts/redwood/bundles/2026.03.15/poc-ctl) size: 6.1GB
Katie: can we share a red-team pen test? we have a 3rd-party pentest report from 2025 we can share under NDA — I'll prep a redacted excerpt.
Maria: they also want a concise rollback/runbook for upgrades to include in the SOW.
Jordan: quick runbook snippet:
```
1. Pre-checks: verify manifest signature and SBOM
2. Stage: import bundle into offline registry (sha256 verify)
3. Apply delta to runtime (apply-chunks.sh)
4. Smoke tests: health endpoints + sample prompts
5. If fail: rollback via snapshot restore and revert manifest
```
I'll attach a scripted helper and health-check examples.
Sam: @Maria I'll handle SOW language for license renewal cadence and the POC discount (will draft by EOD Fri).
Maria: thanks all — next steps: Alex to confirm POC pricing terms in SOW, Jordan to attach bundle sizes + runbook, Katie to attach SBOM & pen-test excerpt. I'll follow up with customer Monday. :thumbsup:
